title: 699. K Empty Slots

examples.explanation: On day 2 the lamps at positions 1 and 3 are on with exactly one gap at position 2.
No day leaves exactly one unlit slot between two lit lamps.
Day 8 is the earliest day with two empty slots between lit neighbors.

hints: Invert the input: days[position] records when that slot lights up.
A valid window [l, r] with r = l + k + 1 needs days[l] and days[r] earlier than every day inside.
Slide the window with two pointers, jumping past any interior day that blooms too early.
